evidence: Ellipsometry measurements on Si substrates were used to investigate growth characteristics. X-ray diffraction on films with a thickness of ∼20 nm confirmed the presence of crystalline Fe2O3. Raman spectroscopy was used to distinguish between iron oxide phases. Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) and Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) images were used to examine the quality of the ALD films. Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDX) element mapping confirmed homogenous coverage by Fe2O3. Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy (STEM) coupled with EDX analysis was used to investigate the quality of the Fe2O3 thin film deposition on a single TiO2 NW. Time-of-Flight Elastic Recoil Detection Analysis (TOF-ERDA) was performed to analyze carbon contamination. Photoelectrochemical Characterization was used to assess the photoelectrochemical performance. Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS) measurements were carried out to extract charge carrier densities. UV-Vis Measurements were used to measure absorptance.
